reason: I buy my panels and batteries myself in the market, shop by shop, and the electrician my cousin used wires it for me. I don't need an app to send my request to companies I've never heard of. They'll just quote me shop prices plus their profit.
objection: These listed companies are strangers, and an app with ratings from people I don't know won't change that. A company price is always higher than what I can haggle in the souq myself.
would_change_my_mind: If my relative's installer or a shop I already trust was on it, or someone I know said the quotes came in cheaper than the market, I might send one request just to compare.
